# 1 bed apartment for sale

> 10 Block C Smithfield Market is an impressively spacious one-bedroom apartment, ideally positioned on the second floor of this ever-fashionable development in Smithfield. This stylishly decorated apartment offers excellent views across Smithfield towards the city centre, an idyllic retreat for those searching for a city centre home.

- Lokalita: 10 Block C Smithfield Market, Smithfield
